rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm check: rule9 exists so bold reliably signals a named handle (law/governor/coined-term/checklist-item); the categorical clause 'Kickers/koans/quotes never bold' protects that signal independent of the per-slide count, so a single well-under-budget bold can still trip it if it's the wrong KIND. Located all 10 bold spans in the body (grep -n '\*\*'): line10 = the mandated check_pedagogy.md §34 task-sizing floor+ceiling callout in ## Prework, N/A by name. Lines20-23 = the ## What You'll Learn template's one-word bolded LO verbs, N/A by name. Lines63/65/67/69 = the reading-list-menu exception's mode-word-only bolds ('Read,'/'Watch,'/'Read,'/'Read (longer),'), title left plain each time, N/A by name. Line29 chunk4: '**The question, to you:** which task have you been putting off...' -- a bolded rhetorical address opening the room prompt. This is not a named law/governor/coined-term/checklist-item; it is functionally a kicker (a punchy lead-in before the actual question), which rule9 bans by category, not by count -- chunk4 carries only this one bold, well inside the <=1 budget, so the count is not the defect. Checked the maintainer block for an accept-note covering this line: grep -n 'kicker\|The question, to you\|Slide size accepted\|Slide deixis accepted' run-the-first-experiment.md -> only the line itself, no accept-note. Ran grep -n 'The question' across all AE101 module files: the identical bolded-kicker shape also opens getting-going.md (M1, line38, 'The question (to you):') and plan-mode-done-right.md (M3, line27, 'The question, to you:'), while earn-the-trust.md uses the same phrase UNBOLDED (line31). This is a corpus-wide, inconsistently-applied pattern, not a one-off slip in this file -- rule9 names only two carve-outs (§34 callouts, LO-bullet template) and this shape fits neither, so filing it here rather than silently waving it through on the strength of an unstated house habit. The obvious fix (drop the bold) would not degrade the beat -- the room-question still reads fine plain -- so this is filed as a TODO, not suppressed as a rule question.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Unbold 'The question, to you:' and let it run as plain narrative, or -- since the identical bolded-kicker shape recurs in getting-going.md and plan-mode-done-right.md -- raise it once as a corpus-wide question: either name a third rule9 carve-out for this recurring module-opener kicker, or sweep-fix all three/four instances together rather than one file at a time.
